summary.zh-CN: 补齐 App 数据的查看、保留、恢复和永久删除，让卸载后的个人数据继续可见、可恢复、可管理。
summary.en-US: Completes the App-data lifecycle with visible storage, data-preserving uninstall, recovery, and explicit permanent deletion.

body.zh-CN: Apps 会列出卸载后保留的数据，并显示 App、受管路径、六类占用和独立永久删除入口。
body.en-US: Apps lists data kept after uninstall with the App identity, managed path, six storage classes, and a dedicated permanent-delete action.

body.zh-CN: App 与 Workspace Service 删除都默认保留个人数据，只有显式选择才会同时永久删除。
body.en-US: App and Workspace Service removal keep personal data by default and delete it only after an explicit choice.

title.zh-CN: 安全的 CLI 数据管理

body.zh-CN: CLI 可以列出 active/retained 数据；永久删除必须同时匹配 data id 和确认的 App id。
body.en-US: The CLI lists active and retained data, while permanent deletion requires both the data id and a matching App-id confirmation.

body.zh-CN: 开发态 Service 可以带确认重置当前源码 identity 的实例，不影响同名 App 的其他数据。
body.en-US: Development Services can reset the instance for the current source identity without touching other data for the same App name.

title.zh-CN: Workspace Service 不再留下隐藏残留

body.zh-CN: 保留的数据进入统一清单；source、数据和 grants 删除失败时会明确报告并尽可能恢复。
body.en-US: Kept data enters the shared inventory, while failures removing source, data, or grants are reported and recovered whenever possible.

body.zh-CN: 更新、回滚和同一发布者重装继续复用现有 instance；外部授权文档从不随 App 数据删除。
body.en-US: Updates, rollbacks, and same-publisher reinstalls reuse the existing instance, while externally granted documents are never deleted with App data.
